about: Raids an enemy village and, if radius is above 0, then the other enemy villages around it, keeping away from armies above a set strength.
calls_back: a large army comes near the raiders, or there is nothing left to raid

radius: after the first village, raid the others within this distance of it; 0 raids only the first
avoid_ratio: pull back into the nearest friendly castle or town when enemies this many times its strength come near
avoid_radius: how near counts for that, in map units

when.poke: Enemies too strong came near {me}'s raid on {target} (strength {enemy_strength_near(me, avoid_radius)} against {strength}); pulling back.
{me} has nothing left to raid around {at}.

away.about: pulling back from the raid on {target}

when.if: hours_in_state >= 6 and enemy_strength_near(me, avoid_radius * 1.5) < strength * avoid_ratio
